persona_evidence.security-lens-reviewer: security-risk: an explicit user grant to auto-merge to a default branch and auto-delete refs in a repository that propagates to three global agent install roots makes proof-command provenance, adapter-absence polarity, containment authority, delivery-state eligibility, and grant binding a new privileged trust boundary.

residual_items.title: This repository has no forge CI, so required-checks-green had no satisfiable adapter
residual_items.constraint: R15a permits only a repository-native deterministic gate resolved from the authoritative default branch to satisfy required-checks-green, bounded by R13a ownership and R13b attribution. Slice 003 must name the satisfying adapter in the receipt and must keep R14b's protected-path stop so skills, agents, instructions, cmd, internal, scripts, and config/skill-quality.json changes never auto-merge.

residual_items.title: Report and receipt metadata carry operational detail that reconciler R23a treats as sensitive
residual_items.constraint: R1b binds the pairing report, grant record, and decision packet to minimum fields, redaction of protected-path and credential-like details, least-privilege permissions, and policy-defined retention. Slice 001 must prove redaction with a credential-like path fixture.
